purpose: A vetted source directory, not pre-certified numeric observations or historically accurate boundary files. Student visualizations remain provisional until each observation is independently checked.

sources.name: Consumer Price Index: All Urban Consumers, All Items, U.S. City Average
sources.time_coverage: Retrieve selected monthly publication dates from BLS database
sources.measurement_unit: index (verify base period in selected release)
sources.accessible_alternative: BLS series tables / downloadable text files
sources.caveats: Unadjusted CPI-U; do not treat an index level as the inflation percentage or compare without consistent base.

sources.name: Real Gross Domestic Product
sources.time_coverage: Quarterly real GDP since 1947 as described by BEA
sources.measurement_unit: inflation-adjusted dollars (confirm chained-dollar reference year and annualization at extraction)
sources.accessible_alternative: BEA on-page real GDP tables, workbook downloads and NIPA documentation
sources.caveats: GDP measures output, not distribution or individual welfare; estimates may be revised.

sources.name: Historical Decennial Population Tables
sources.time_coverage: Selected decennial census years; data availability differs by table
sources.geographic_scope: United States and geographic subdivisions as indicated in selected table
sources.measurement_unit: persons or other published table-specific measure
sources.accessible_alternative: Census accessible tables and downloadable XLS/CSV/PDF
sources.caveats: Geographic definitions and questionnaire categories vary across censuses; source exact table and year.

certification_policy: No fabricated values, extrapolated territorial boundaries, or automated validation claims. Grade 9–12 teachers must validate the actual observations and attach named reference, date, geographic coverage and data table before students use them as fact.
